name: Jorah projects
description: See and steer the projects Jorah's project runner works on (docs/plan/11-project-mode.md section 5): list, status, the founder digest, Adam's answers and task results (with photos he sent), run now, pause, resume and limits. Reads the registry, the runner's state and the project folder; writes only the runner's inbox and requests, and one project's limits. Starts no work itself.

stateRoot.description: The runner's state, /home/jorah/.jorah-projects (one folder per project, mode 700)

workRoot.description: Where project repos live when an entry has no workDir, /home/jorah/work

guardStateDir.description: jorah-guard's state folder, read only for its FROZEN file

workspace.description: main's workspace, for attachment paths given relative to it (media/inbound/...)

mediaRoots.description: Folders where OpenClaw keeps received attachments; a file path outside them is refused unless the plugin saw it arrive in the same chat

gitBin.description: git, for counting commits not yet on GitHub
